text: Mechanics is a fundamental discipline that studies the laws of mechanical motion of matter. It takes mathematics and physics as its theoretical core and explores the interaction between force and motion. It not only encompasses the fundamental theories of classical mechanics (such as Newtonian mechanics), but also involves the cross-application of modern mechanics in fields like engineering, aerospace, and biomedicine. As a bridge between engineering and science, the mechanics major aims to cultivate talents with solid theoretical foundations and interdisciplinary application capabilities, dedicated to solving mechanical problems in engineering practice (such as structural strength, fluid flow, material deformation, etc.).
